verdict.rationale: Capsule documents team-shared email templates and sending email from inside Capsule through a connected mailbox, which covers the templated-email half of the story. Tracks are sequential task series, not automated email sequences, so they earn no credit for multi-step email sequences. missing for 10: multi-step email sequence/cadence capability, in-depth docs on applying templates when sending, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send templated emails or multi-step sequences to prospects from inside the CRM

citations.quote: Create and save email templates in Capsule for the whole team to use.
Connect your mailbox and send emails from within Capsule in just a few clicks.
